ex.en: O People of the Scripture, there has come to you Our Messenger to make clear to you [the religion] after a period [of suspension] of messengers, lest you say, "There came not to us any bringer of good tidings or a warner." But there has come to you a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And Allah is over all things competent
They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken
It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair
